'''Voltling''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Voltkit]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Voltverine]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Voltling believes a true hero needs a proper finishing pose. The current goal? Win every battle without damaging that blade of grass."

Voltling is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A yellow and white wolf that wears a red bandana around its neck and has a scar across one eye. It's also always holding a blade of grass in its mouth.

Voltling's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with blue, and red becomes yellow.

==Evolution Trial==
Voltling's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Voltverine]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Voltling to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 70 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x4200 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "That's not tobacco sticking out of Voltling's mouth. We don't approve of young wolves smoking!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Voltling's scarf was a gift from a personal hero and is never removed. Always strikes a righteous pose when making an appearance."
